verdict.rationale: Supabase's first-party Realtime docs offer 'Postgres Changes: Listen to database changes in real-time', and the GitHub README lists 'Realtime subscriptions' as an auto-generated API, so clients can subscribe to data changes instead of polling. A community launch thread describing the Elixir/Phoenix Realtime server confirms the subsystem exists, but documentation of the subscription flow itself is thin. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the client subscription API and event filtering, how RLS applies to realtime streams, and independent hands-on confirmation of live UI updates.
